home.faqDesc: Quick answers to common questions about files, conversions, privacy and availability.
home.faqQ1: How does AJN PDF handle my files?
home.faqA1: The method depends on the tool. Each tool page explains how it handles files, and the file-processing policy gives the full details.
home.faqA2: AJN PDF does not provide permanent document storage for these tools. When a workflow needs temporary processing, files are removed after delivery according to the file-processing policy.
home.faqQ3: Can AJN PDF unlock a file without the password?
home.faqA3: No. Unlock PDF requires the current valid password and confirmation that you own the document or have permission to remove its protection.
home.faqQ4: Will every conversion look exactly the same?
home.faqA4: Complex layouts, scans and uncommon formats can vary during conversion. Important limitations are shown where relevant, and important results should be reviewed before final use.
home.faqA5: Advertising can depend on your consent choice, ad blockers, regional requirements, available inventory and the advertising service.
home.faqQ6: Which tools appear in the directory?
home.faqA6: The directory shows tools that are ready for public use. Tools still being tested stay out of the main experience until they meet release checks.
home.faqHelpTitle: Need help with a specific tool?
home.faqHelpDesc: Open the full FAQ or contact AJN PDF with the tool name and the issue you see.
